label: 05 Notifications
info: Delivers alerts to a webhook (Slack, Teams, Discord, ntfy, Zapier/Make...). Off until MF_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL is set in .env. Reads the queue in mf.pending_deliveries() and reports results through mf.mark_delivery().

name: alerts -> webhook (set MF_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL in .env to turn on)
info: Formats via MF_NOTIFY_FORMAT: json (default) | slack | discord | text (plain body, works with ntfy). MF_NOTIFY_BEARER_TOKEN adds an Authorization header. The webhook URL is a secret: keep it in .env only.
